contracts.signal: Vantage and Liberty Power Innovations (LPI), a Liberty Energy company, will partner to deliver up to one gigawatt (1GW) of power agreements between LPI and end-users of Vantage's data centers within the next five years, including a reservation of 400 megawatts (MW) of 2027 power generation capacity; the power solutions will be owned and operated by LPI.
